extra_vocab.zh: 有成就的人、表現傑出的人（複數）
extra_vocab.en: people who do very well and reach their goals
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，top achievers 指業績最優秀、被公司邀請參加獎勵活動（retreat）的員工。achiever 指的是「人」，不是成就本身。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: achiever 是可數名詞，指「人」；成就本身是 achievement，動詞 achieve 是及物動詞，後面直接接 goal、target，不加 to。

example.en: She was named the top achiever in the sales department this year.
example.zh: 她今年被選為業務部門表現最優異的人。

example.en: Our recruiters look for high achievers who work well in teams.
example.zh: 我們的招募人員在尋找善於團隊合作的高成就者。

examples.en: The award ceremony honors the achievers from every regional office.
examples.zh: 頒獎典禮表揚各區域分公司的傑出人員。

examples.en: Top achievers receive a bonus and an invitation to the annual retreat.
examples.zh: 頂尖表現者會獲得獎金，並受邀參加年度活動。

examples.en: The training program is designed for achievers who want to become managers.
examples.zh: 這項培訓計畫是為想成為主管的傑出人員設計的。

confusable.diff: achiever 是「有成就的人」，achievement 是「成就、成果」這件事。

example.en: Winning the national award was a major achievement for the company.
example.zh: 贏得全國大獎是公司的一大成就。

confusable.diff: 拼法相近，但 archive 是「檔案館、存檔」，與成就無關。

example.en: Please store the old reports in the company archive after the audit.
example.zh: 稽核結束後，請把舊報告存放在公司檔案庫。

similar.diff: 常用在人資與績效評估，指工作表現好的人；achiever 帶有「達成目標」的意味。

example.en: The manager praised the high performers on the sales team.
example.zh: 經理稱讚了業務團隊中表現優異的人。

example.en: The recipient of this year's award will be announced on Friday.
example.zh: 今年的獲獎者將在週五公布。

example.en: The winner of the sales contest will receive a trip to Bali.
example.zh: 業績競賽的優勝者將獲得峇里島旅遊。

example.en: Her performance this quarter was well above the team average.
example.zh: 她這一季的表現遠高於團隊平均。

derived.link: 最基礎的動詞；achieve + -er，做這件事的人，像 worker、manager

extra_vocab.en: feeling that something is very good and deserves respect
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，were impressed by the scale of the event 是飯店客氣地表示對活動規模印象深刻，帶有正面、禮貌的語氣。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 人感到印象深刻用 impressed（be impressed by / with + 事物）；造成印象的事物或結果用 impressive，不能說 The result is impressed。

example.en: Her careful planning always impresses the senior managers at our company.
example.zh: 她縝密的規劃總是讓公司的高階主管印象深刻。

example.en: Impressing a new client takes more than a good presentation.
example.zh: 要讓新客戶留下深刻印象，不只需要一場好的簡報。

example.en: Customers were impressed by how quickly the staff solved the problem.
example.zh: 顧客對員工解決問題的速度之快印象深刻。

example.en: The board was impressed with her clear and confident presentation.
example.zh: 董事會對她清楚又自信的簡報印象深刻。

example.en: We were highly impressed with the quality of the samples.
example.zh: 我們對樣品的品質印象非常深刻。

examples.en: The interviewers were impressed by her experience in international sales.
examples.zh: 面試官對她的國際業務經驗印象深刻。

examples.en: Our client was impressed that the team finished the work early.
examples.zh: 我們的客戶對團隊提早完工印象深刻。

examples.en: Everyone in the meeting was impressed after seeing the test results.
examples.zh: 看到測試結果後，會議中的每個人都印象深刻。

confusable.diff: impressed 形容「感到」印象深刻的人；impressive 形容「令人」印象深刻的事物。
confusable.usage: 主詞是人用 impressed（The client was impressed），主詞是事物或結果用 impressive（The result is impressive）。

example.en: The company reported an impressive increase in online orders last quarter.
example.zh: 公司報告上一季網路訂單有令人印象深刻的成長。

confusable.diff: 拼法與發音相近，但 expressed 是 express（表達）的過去式。

example.en: The manager expressed her thanks to the whole team.
example.zh: 經理向全體團隊表達了謝意。

similar.diff: 只是滿意、高興，語氣比 impressed 弱，不一定有佩服的意思。

example.en: We are pleased with the results of the customer survey.
example.zh: 我們對顧客調查的結果感到滿意。

similar.diff: 語氣更強烈，常指被某個特點吸引注意。

example.en: She was struck by the friendly atmosphere in the new office.
example.zh: 她對新辦公室友善的氣氛印象深刻。

example.en: Many employees admire the director's honest and open leadership style.
example.zh: 許多員工很欣賞總監坦率開放的領導風格。

example.en: The client praised the team for meeting every deadline.
example.zh: 客戶稱讚團隊趕上了每一個期限。

example.en: Most customers said they were satisfied with the new delivery service.
example.zh: 大多數顧客表示對新的配送服務感到滿意。

example.en: The investors were impressed by the firm's steady growth over three years.
example.zh: 投資人對這家公司三年來的穩定成長印象深刻。

example.en: The new design impressed everyone who attended the trade show.
example.zh: 新設計讓每位參加貿易展的人都印象深刻。

extra_vocab.en: paid by a company to work for it
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡是被動句 is employed by your company，指每位賓客都是這家公司的在職員工，作為申請優惠價的資格證明。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: employ 是及物動詞，表示「受僱於某公司」用被動：be employed by + 公司（或 at + 地點）；employed 也可當形容詞，表示「有工作的」，反義是 unemployed。

example.en: The factory employs more than two hundred workers in the region.
example.zh: 這間工廠在當地僱用了兩百多名員工。

example.en: Employing local staff helps the company understand its customers better.
example.zh: 僱用當地員工有助於公司更了解自己的顧客。

example.en: All sales staff are employed by the regional office, not headquarters.
example.zh: 所有業務人員都受僱於區域辦公室，而不是總公司。

example.en: The new plant will employ workers from nearby towns.
example.zh: 新工廠會僱用附近城鎮的工人。

example.en: We decided to employ a consultant to review the budget.
example.zh: 我們決定聘請一位顧問來審查預算。

examples.en: We plan to employ three more engineers before the product launch.
examples.zh: 我們打算在產品上市前再僱用三位工程師。

examples.en: Applicants must be employed full time to qualify for the loan.
examples.zh: 申請人必須是全職受僱，才符合貸款資格。

examples.en: Retail is the industry that employs the largest number of people here.
examples.zh: 零售業是這裡僱用人數最多的產業。

confusable.diff: 拼法與發音相近，但 deployed 是「部署、調派」人員或資源。

example.en: Extra security staff were deployed at the entrance during the event.
example.zh: 活動期間，額外的保全人員被調派到入口處。

similar.diff: hire 強調「聘用」這個動作與決定，口語、常用；employ 較正式，也指持續僱用的狀態。

example.en: We will hire two new analysts after the budget is approved.
example.zh: 預算核准後，我們會聘用兩位新的分析師。

family.zh: 資遣（因業務縮減，不是員工的錯）

example.en: The company had to lay off fifty workers after sales dropped.
example.zh: 銷售下滑後，公司不得不資遣五十名員工。

family.zh: 解僱（因表現或過失，較正式）

example.en: He was dismissed after breaking the company's safety rules.
example.zh: 他因為違反公司安全規定而被解僱。

example.en: The manager fired the contractor for missing every deadline.
example.zh: 經理因為承包商每次都沒趕上期限而把他開除。

example.en: She resigned to start her own consulting business.
example.zh: 她辭職去開創自己的顧問公司。

derived.link: un- + employed，不被僱用的，像 unhappy、unable
un- + employment，沒有就業，也就是「失業（率）」

example.en: The company plans to employ twenty new technicians this summer.
example.zh: 公司計畫今年夏天僱用二十位新技術人員。

example.en: Over ninety percent of our graduates are employed within six months.
example.zh: 我們超過九成的畢業生在六個月內就有工作。

senses.en: to pay someone to work for you

example.en: The hotel employs a full-time manager for its guest events.
example.zh: 這間飯店僱用一位全職經理負責住客活動。

senses.en: to use something for a purpose
senses.distinguish: 受詞是人就是「僱用」；受詞是方法、技術就是「使用」，語氣較正式。

example.en: The team employs a new method to test every product.
example.zh: 團隊採用新的方法來測試每一項產品。

extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡是被動句 was halted，指東翼整修工程因許可證糾紛被迫暫停，不是自願停工，之後有可能再開始。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: halt 的過去式與過去分詞都是 halted；當及物動詞時受詞常是 work、production 等（halt production），被動 be halted 表示被迫暫停。

example.en: Heavy snow halts train service along the northern line every winter.
example.zh: 每年冬天，大雪都會讓北線的火車停駛。

example.en: Halting production for repairs cost the plant nearly a full day.
example.zh: 為了維修而停止生產，使工廠損失了將近一整天。

example.en: The plant had to halt production because of a parts shortage.
example.zh: 工廠因為零件短缺而不得不停止生產。

example.en: Traffic may come to a halt near the airport during the evening rush hour.
example.zh: 傍晚尖峰時段，機場附近的交通可能會完全停下來。

example.en: Storms forced the airline to halt operations at two airports.
example.zh: 暴風雨迫使航空公司暫停兩座機場的營運。

examples.en: The council halted the road project until the budget was approved.
examples.zh: 市議會在預算核准前叫停了這項道路工程。

examples.en: A customs problem halted the shipment at the border for two days.
examples.zh: 海關問題讓貨物在邊境停留了兩天。

examples.en: Updates were halted when the server suddenly stopped responding.
examples.zh: 伺服器突然沒有回應時，更新作業就被中止了。

confusable.diff: 拼法相近，但 halve 是「使減半」，不是停止。

example.en: The new system will halve our processing time by next year.
example.zh: 新系統將在明年把我們的處理時間減半。

similar.diff: suspend 較正式，多指有計畫地暫時停止；halted 常是被意外或外力叫停。

example.en: The airline suspended flights to the island because of the storm.
example.zh: 航空公司因為暴風雨暫停了飛往該島的航班。

similar.diff: stall 指自己停滯、卡住（談判、引擎），不一定是被叫停。

example.en: Talks stalled when the two sides could not agree on price.
example.zh: 雙方無法在價格上達成共識，談判因而停滯。

example.en: Please pause the video so we can discuss the first slide.
example.zh: 請暫停影片，讓我們討論第一張投影片。

example.en: Bad weather may delay the delivery of the new equipment.
example.zh: 惡劣天氣可能會延遲新設備的送達。

example.en: A power failure interrupted the presentation for several minutes.
example.zh: 停電使簡報中斷了好幾分鐘。

example.en: The manager decided to halt the experiment until the results were checked.
example.zh: 經理決定在確認結果之前先中止這項實驗。

example.en: The strike brought all deliveries to a complete halt.
example.zh: 罷工使所有的配送完全停擺。
